blocks.text: For the first time ever, Thailand will be hosting The Miss Globe pageant, something that has piqued the curiosity of Binibining Pilipinas Sasha Lacuna, who is representing the country at this year’s edition of the international competition. Nawat Itsaragrisil’s Miss Grand International Organization will be mounting The Miss Globe 2026 pageant in Phuket, that will run from Oct. 24 to Nov. 7. The Thai organizer had just wrapped up the staging of the 14th Miss Grand International pageant in Bangkok, a sudden move from what was supposed to be India’s first time hosting his pageant.
